case_name: Jasleen Kaur Sidhu vs Shikhar Kacker
facts_of_case: The parties got acquainted in 2010 and married in 2014. The wife sought interim maintenance under Section 24 of the Hindu Marriage Act. The trial court partly allowed her application. The husband appeals for enhancement of the amount.

legal_principles.principle: Where in any proceeding under this Act it appears to the court that either the wife or the husband has no independent income sufficient for her or his support and the necessary expenses of the proceeding, it may order the respondent to pay to the petitioner the expenses of the proceeding, and monthly during the proceeding such sum as it may seem to the court to be reasonable.
legal_principles.held: The provision of Section 24 of the Hindu Marriage Act deals with a provision for the purposes of remittance of maintenance pendentelite subject to satisfying of the conditions, which have been provided therein under the provision.

outcome.final_order: The final order enhanced the amount of maintenance granted to the wife.
